Opposition Parties Divided on Delimitation Bill Ahead of Monsoon Session

As India's Parliament prepares for its Monsoon session, a Delimitation Bill has become a point of contention among opposition parties. While some, like Congress, are seeking an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister to discuss the bill, others, including NCP (SP), have not yet decided their stance. Reports suggest potential support for the bill from certain opposition factions, raising questions about overall opposition unity.
